patches.reason: Connect the complete Android 17 AOSP Dialer Telecom lifecycle to model priority and the fail-closed AIOS Call Intelligence policy and capture service.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if AOSP exposes an equivalent stable call-assistant lifecycle API requiring no Dialer source hook.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked Dialer base, preserve the four-file footprint, then rerun host validation, preview builds, emulator Telecom smoke, and every physical dialer/call gate.

patches.reason: Allow the platform-signed AIOS Messaging app to statically link AOSP's maintained MMS codec and Telephony provider persister without copying protocol sources into vendor code, using Soong's required platform-to-vendor subtree visibility boundary.
patches.removal_condition: Remove when framework-mms-shared-srcs is public to product modules or AOSP provides an equivalent supported MMS codec and provider library.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked frameworks/base commit, keep the change to the single telephony/common/Android.bp visibility entry using //vendor:__subpackages__, and rebuild AiosMessaging with Soong.

patches.reason: Preserve AOSP's compliance-GSI defaults while allowing an additive product to provide a larger build container for its catalog-pinned on-device models.
patches.removal_condition: Remove when BoardConfigGsiCommon uses conditional defaults or exposes an equivalent product-supported GSI sizing mechanism.
patches.rebase_notes: Re-export from the tracked build/make base, preserve the two assignment-operator changes only, verify the default GSI remains 3 GiB without overrides, verify the AIOS dumpvars are 6 GiB plus 8 MiB, then rebuild the model-inclusive ARM64 GSI.
